candidates.change_summary: Change the airdrop credit amount from 20 to 21 so tokenBalance ends higher than in P.
Delete the balance increment statement so airDrop never changes tokenBalance.
Delete `_locked = true;` so the reentrancy lock never engages, allowing a reentrant airDrop call to add 20 twice.
Change hasNoBalance to require balance <= 20 so callers with small nonzero balances pass and receive extra tokens.
Change the compared string to "Nu Token2" so supportsToken always reverts for legitimate callers.
Change the airdrop credit from +20 to +40 tokens.
Remove the reset of _locked at the end of the modifier so the lock stays engaged.
Change hasNoBalance to require a nonzero balance, inverting the guard.
Change the required token name string so supportsToken never matches Bank's return.
